title: CI cannot distinguish a GitHub Actions platform outage from a real failure
symptom: A platform outage renders on a PR as a red X identical to a failed test. 12/12 runs before 15:22Z succeeded; every cancellation and failure today falls after the incident opened.
root_cause: GitHub Actions major_outage (incident 'Incident with Actions', impact critical, opened 2026-08-06T15:22:49Z). Webhook triggers throttled, so runs are never created and queued jobs are never assigned a runner. NOT runner capacity.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-flight step queries githubstatus.com components API for the Actions component
Outage surfaced as an explicit annotation naming the incident
Pre-check is diagnostic only: never fails the build, never masks a genuine failure
CLAUDE.md requires checking the status API before reporting red CI as acceptable
notes: Opposite defect to ISS-0171/#498, which HID real failures via continue-on-error.
Last 40 runs: 31 success, 6 cancelled, 3 failure -- only 3 are genuine code failures.
correction_note: Originally filed as 'runner starvation' from runner-assignment evidence alone. That inference was wrong because githubstatus.com was never checked. Corrected 2026-08-06; the remedy changed from capacity tuning to outage attribution.
